scope: verifier-side only; never injected into the agent environment
revision_note: Revision 2026-10-12 (task version 2.1.1): the four llm_judge reviewer items were retired. The effective score has always been the binary required F2P/P2P gate and no per-candidate reviewer score was ever collected, so the 0.5 llm_judge weight described a score that did not exist. The programmatic weights below were normalised from a 0.5 budget to 1.0 by doubling each item. Deprecation record: REFIT-2026-10-12.md. Revision 2026-10-13 adds the version / structure / varint carrying cases to error-classification so that every kind declared by the task statement is carried by at least one testcase.

programmatic.description: The authoritative samples verify, round-trip byte for byte, and expose the documented record sequence.
programmatic.pass_condition: verify() accepts both assets/sample.wfmt and assets/sample_empty.wfmt; pack(unpack(sample)) reproduces the sample byte for byte; unpack(sample) yields exactly the documented (tag, payload) sequence in file order.
programmatic.failure_reason: The implementation rejects or misreads the authoritative samples, or re-packing a parsed sample produces different bytes (which breaks downstream byte-hash incremental sync).

programmatic.description: The trailer is a general 32-bit CRC variant that covers the header and the records and detects content tampering.
programmatic.pass_condition: compute_crc() matches a published standard check value for a known test vector; verify() returns False once record content is altered; the checksum is computed over the header and every record, so tampering in either region is detected.
programmatic.failure_reason: The checksum is a private or truncated fold that agrees with the sample only by accident, is computed over a subset of the container, or silently accepts tampered content.

programmatic.description: Structural and integrity problems surface as a classified WFormatError covering every kind declared by the task statement, and verify() never raises.
programmatic.pass_condition: A container cut short before its complete structure raises WFormatError with kind 'truncated'; a wrong magic raises WFormatError with kind 'magic'; an unsupported version byte raises WFormatError with kind 'version'; a record count that disagrees with the container length, and non-zero alignment padding, both raise WFormatError with kind 'structure'; a uvarint that exceeds the 63-bit encoding bound raises WFormatError with kind 'varint'; verify() returns False for every malformed input instead of propagating ValueError, struct.error or IndexError.
programmatic.failure_reason: Malformed input leaks a built-in exception, a kind declared by the task statement has no carrying case, the error kind does not distinguish the documented categories, or verify() raises instead of returning False.

programmatic.description: iter_records() is lazy, reads only through bounded read(n) calls whose window does not grow with the input size, still validates the trailer once the last record has been produced, and read_all() agrees with unpack().
programmatic.pass_condition: iter_records() never issues an unbounded read; when the container has been read in full the number of records still pending does not grow when the input grows 8x (a bounded buffer keeps it constant); a stream that ends early raises WFormatError(kind='truncated'); a container whose trailer checksum was altered is fully iterated and then rejected with WFormatError(kind='checksum'); read_all() returns the same records as unpack().
programmatic.failure_reason: The iterator buffers the whole container (read()/read(-1)/readlines()), its read window grows with the input, it skips the trailer checksum so a bad checksum is accepted, or read_all() disagrees with unpack().

programmatic.description: Generated containers round-trip across small, empty and randomised payloads, and pack/verify agree.
programmatic.pass_condition: pack/unpack round-trip for multi-byte varint tags and empty payloads; pack(data) is accepted by both verify() and iter_records() for generated data.
programmatic.failure_reason: Round-trip only works for the sample shape, varint boundaries or empty payloads break, or pack() and verify() disagree on freshly generated containers.
